tex_content.html:
Proposition
1. ch4:4.18Let $M$ be a smooth manifold with or without boundary, let $\nabla $ be a connection in $TM$, and let $(E_i)$ be a smooth local frame with connection coefficients $\Gamma ^k_{ij}$. For a $(k,l)$-tensor $F$, \[ \begin{aligned} F^{i_1\cdots i_k}_{j_1\cdots j_l;m} ={}& E_m\bigl(F^{i_1\cdots i_k}_{j_1\cdots j_l}\bigr) +\sum _{s=1}^kF^{i_1\cdots p\cdots i_k}_{j_1\cdots j_l}\Gamma ^{i_s}_{mp}\\ & -\sum _{s=1}^lF^{i_1\cdots i_k}_{j_1\cdots p\cdots j_l}\Gamma ^p_{mj_s}. \end{aligned} \]
